scope: Backlog16 low-Re Ghia cavity and17 nonperiodic manufactured wall flow. Six fixed flow grids, three separate pressure operator solves. No high-Re scan, turbulence, independent dense reference regeneration, or quantum calculation.
model: Real 2D incompressible vorticity transport with Poisson coupling and no-slip nonperiodic walls. Same centered FD/Heun/Thom solver for both flow cases.
analytic_derivation: psi=A f(x)f(y), f=z²(1−z)²; u=psi_y, v=−psi_x, omega=−Delta psi; forcing=u*omega_x+v*omega_y−nu*Delta omega. f''''=24. Qualify against independently differentiated tensor polynomial coefficients.
wall_derivation: Thom wall omega=−2psi_adj/h² on stationary walls; top adds−2U/h. Local wall omega truncation is O(h), not claimed second-order. Require actual wall omega and velocity-gradient shear errors decrease and publish observed rates. Exact MMS omega never sets boundary values.
pressure: Pressure gauge not applicable to streamfunction evolution. A separate p=x²+y²+sin(pi*x)sin(pi*y) with analytic nonzero Dirichlet boundary checks Poisson and interior/one-sided boundary gradients. This does not validate cavity pressure.
